challenge.better_approach: Fix all seven sites in one ticket: faster, but a ticket's build lives inside its own component (RULE 1), so one ticket per component is the shape.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That scratch_dir's atexit sweep is safe for these proofs: each uses the dir only inside its own process, checked by reading each site.

answers.how: At each site, replace Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=P)) with scratch_dir(P), imported from cairn.tools.scratch.scratch, and drop the tempfile import where nothing else uses it: cairn/tools/validation_store/proofs/test_source_files_are_lf_on_every_box.py:52 (tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="cairn-eol-pin-proof-")), landed under 88e30cde9bd4); cairn/tools/validation_store/proofs/test_the_hook_source_checks_out_lf.py:64 (tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="cairn-hook-pin-proof-")), landed under daaf7ac3e4ec). Precedent: cc_0's 9859b8d64 (ticket 383ac6351996): the LF hook proof took its temp dir from scratch_dir after the scratch-door proof redded its bare mkdtemp. New red-first proof cairn/tools/validation_store/proofs/test_validation_stores_proofs_reach_temp_only_through_the_scratch_door.py, the pattern of cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_base_proofs_reach_temp_only_through_the_scratch_door.py: one tooth test_no_proof_in_validation_store_reaches_temp_bare asserting bare_temp_reach(REPO / 'cairn/tools/validation_store') == [], the scan bound at call time. Proofs-only build: the ticket carries a top-level writes_to.
answers.traces_to: Law 4 (the scratch door is physics, and these lines step around it) and CP6 (what a proof leaves in /tmp accumulates unseen; 3581 dirs did once).
answers.what: Every proof in cairn/tools/validation_store takes its temp directory from cairn.tools.scratch.scratch.scratch_dir, so nothing a validation_store proof makes outlives its run.
